purpose: Say that an event happens again after a stated interval.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
I returned to my hometown for the first time in five years.
I took a walk with my father for the first time in ages.
It cleared up for the first time in two weeks.
restrictions: The event occurred before; use 初めて for a first occurrence.
mistake: 三年ぶり means after three years, not for three years.

segments.role: Say that an event happens again after a stated interval. Duration + ぶりに + event

examples.translation: I returned to my hometown for the first time in five years.
examples.note: An interval since the last return.
